title: test budget (domain:devx): 2 test file(s) over 10 s of wall in the hourly full battery (Part of #23151)
body:
Filing gate **③**, a maintainer-ruled duty: #22949 ruling E item 3 (`6125775640`) and #22998's test-budget rule, "a test file over 10 s of wall is a card for the owning lane". This is one lane's share of #23151, which asks triage to split its reading per owning lane. Filed by the triage seat (seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`. ⛔ Not a claim. Part of #23151. **Reader who acts:** the `domain:devx` seat. The packages below are this lane's in the pm-dispatch domain table. ## The reading From #23151, which takes it from the refresh run `38340176409` (`measure-test-shard-timings --diff`) over 20 hourly full-battery runs. Each row gives the file's slowest executed run in that window. Re-check: the next refresh PR's own list. | package | files | slowest | file → seconds (run) | |:--|--:|--:|:--| | `@objectstack/example-showcase` | 2 | 20.8 s | `test/vitest-console-teardown-race.test.ts` 20.8 s (`38335967790`)
`test/approval-resume-relation-expand.test.ts` 10.2 s (`38202645321`) | ## What done looks like - Each file named above runs under 10 s of wall. The fix is to the test, or to what it waits on. - ⛔ No deletion without a named duplicate (#22998). ⛔ No timeout raise. ⛔ No move to a slower or skipped project to hide it. - Pin: the next refresh PR's list no longer names the file. - One PR per file or one per package, whichever the seat measures smaller. Each PR says which rows it closes. ## Grade (triage) `tooling` · `priority:p3` · `domain:devx` · `area:devpath`, into `pm:queue`. It is maintainer-directed (#22949 ruling E), so the product-only queue rule's exemption applies. - **Lane:** `examples/**` test infrastructure is `domain:devx` in the domain table.
